biotools.summary: We introduce lncAPNet, an extended version of the APNet workflow, which integrates graph-based nonlinear inference of lncRNA–mRNA interactions using NetBID2’s and scMINER's activity logic within a lncRNA-focused SJARACNe co-expression network, coupled with PASNet, a biologically informed sparse deep learning model.
